sources.researchNote: The WaterTower Music-supplied title explicitly identifies the track as an outtake from A Day at the Races and a “2006 Remaster”; the description names Allan Jones, Georgie Stoll and Maurice DePackh. This supports a recording made for the film but not an appearance of the number in the finished film. The structured date is publication of this YouTube access copy on 6 May 2021. The remaster designation does not by itself establish the anthology’s issue date, and the ℗ 1937 notice is not an exact session date. The automated composer fields repeat Kaper and Gus Kahn and do not distinguish music from lyrics; they are not used to revise the work’s authorship credits, which rest on separate sources.
